sourceText:
Vanities Or Cruellers
By: Anonymous
Published: Thursday, December 3, 2009 - 11:38pm

Ingredients




4 eggs
1 heaping tbsp. sugar
Pinch of salt
Flour

Preparation

1 Beat eggs very light. Add sugar, salt, and enough flour to roll out thin as paper. Cut in squares; make little slits in square. Fry in deep fat until lightly brown. They brown fast. Dust with powdered sugar.
